name: pack.png Seed
version: Java Alpha 1.2.0 to 1.2.5 for the closest match (up to Beta 1.7.3 with minor differences)
story: The default server-list icon of Minecraft, pack.png, was added in Alpha 1.2.2 (November 2010) and nobody knew which world it showed. The seed was later found by the community. It is probably the most famous seed in the game.
notes: Load it in Alpha 1.2.2 for the exact original terrain; newer versions generate a different world from the same seed
Per the wiki, it is also the default seed of Bedrock's create-new-world screen when no seed is entered (since beta 1.18.20.21), spawning you in a savanna at -208, 65, 0
keywords: pack png seed server icon famous 3257840388504953787

name: Original Title Screen Panorama
version: Java Beta 1.7.3 (world seen in Beta 1.8 through 1.12)
story: The slowly rotating blurred world behind the Minecraft main menu from Beta 1.8 (2011) to 1.13. The seed was cracked by the Minecraft@Home community on July 18, 2020 after about a month of research. A second valid seed exists - 8091867987493326313 - because old versions used only 48 bits of the seed, so thousands of seeds generate this same world.
notes: Use 2151901553968352745 or 8091867987493326313 in Beta 1.7.3 for the exact panorama world
Stand at X=61.48, Y=75, Z=-68.73 looking the right way to recreate the shot
54.5 exaFLOPs of volunteer computing went into the search
keywords: title screen panorama seed original main menu 2151901553968352745

name: 1.18 Title Screen Panorama
version: Java 21w40a (1.18 snapshot) and later
story: The sunset panorama introduced in 1.18 was cracked by Minecraft@Home in October 2021 - and turned out to be the same seed as the original 2011 panorama, placed 7,000 blocks away. The minecraft.wiki seed list gives the same seed for the original (Beta 1.8 to 18w22c) and 1.18 panoramas.
notes: Same seed as the original panorama - the magic is in the coordinates: X=4.83, Y=130.15, Z=-7294.28
Recreate the shot: /time set 12949 with doDaylightCycle off, facing east
Modern 1.18+ terrain, so it works in current Java versions
keywords: 1.18 panorama seed caves and cliffs title screen sunset easter egg

name: Herobrine Screenshot Seed
version: Java Alpha v1.0.16_02
story: The world behind the most famous Minecraft creepypasta. The original 2010 Herobrine screenshot (the white-eyed 'Steve' in the fog) was a hoax, but the world was real. The seed was later recovered by the community. The Minecraft Launcher later joked in its changelog: 'removed Herobrine from Java Alpha 1.0.16_02'.
notes: Only generates correctly in Alpha v1.0.16_02 (enable historical versions in the launcher)
Herobrine was never in the game: you will find the hill, the trees and the fog, nothing more
keywords: herobrine seed screenshot 478868574082066804 alpha creepypasta famous

name: Herobrine Livestream Seed
version: Java Alpha v1.0.17_04
story: The seed of the Brocraft livestream where streamer Copeland 'encountered' Herobrine live in 2010, the moment the legend truly went viral. The streams themselves were lost media for 14 years until Enderboss25 recovered them in July 2024 from a viewer who had privately archived them. Copeland eventually released the original world download himself.
notes: Generates in Alpha v1.0.17_04 (historical versions in the launcher)
The livestream was staged: the 'Herobrine' was a retextured door/painting trick
The original streams resurfaced in 2024 and are viewable again
Companion to the Herobrine screenshot seed - two different worlds, one myth
keywords: herobrine seed livestream brocraft copeland 3609313613745973624 alpha lost media

name: Skull on Fire Painting Seed
version: Java Alpha v1.1.2_01 or prior
story: The world shown in 'Skull on Fire', one of Minecraft's original Kristoffer Zetterstrand paintings. For over a decade nobody knew whether the burning-skull landscape was a real place. Seed researchers proved it was: the terrain in the painting exists in Alpha terrain generation, and either of two seeds reproduces it (the second is -1044887956651363087, because Alpha worlds only use part of the seed bits).
notes: Generates in Alpha v1.1.2_01 or earlier (historical versions in the launcher)
The painting itself is by Kristoffer Zetterstrand, like most of Minecraft's classic art
One of the last great 'lost' Minecraft images to be reverse-engineered
keywords: skull on fire painting seed -6984854390176336655 zetterstrand alpha famous

name: 1.13 Title Screen Panorama
version: Java snapshot 18w22a (world seen on the 1.13 title screen)
story: The warm coral-reef ocean that rotated behind the main menu during the Update Aquatic era (1.13). Fittingly, the seed was not brute-forced this time: it is simply the text '18w22a' typed into the seed box - the very snapshot the screenshot was taken in - which hashes to 1458140401.
notes: Type 18w22a or 1458140401 - both produce the same world
Load it in any 1.13+ version; the reef spawns in warm ocean terrain
The underwater panorama was Mojang's showcase for Update Aquatic's new oceans
Same panorama family as the original and 1.18 seeds already in this list
keywords: 1.13 panorama seed 1458140401 18w22a title screen update aquatic coral reef

name: 1.19 Title Screen Panorama
version: Java snapshot 22w15a (world seen on the 1.19 title screen)
story: The mangrove swamp panorama that welcomed players to The Wild Update (1.19). Like the 1.13 panorama, the seed hides in plain sight: type 'thewildupdate' into the seed box and the text hashes to -1696067516, the same world Mojang photographed in snapshot 22w15a.
notes: Type thewildupdate or -1696067516 - both produce the same world
Load in 1.19+ for the mangrove swamp terrain
The panorama spotlights the then-new mangrove trees, mud and fireflies-era ambience
Text seeds are hashed with Java's String.hashCode, which is why words become numbers
keywords: 1.19 panorama seed -1696067516 thewildupdate title screen mangrove swamp wild update

name: gargamel Seed
version: Java Beta 1.3 - 1.7.3 (modern versions generate a different world from the same word)
story: The seed that taught the community what seeds were for. Shared on February 25-27, 2011, right after Beta 1.3 added the seed input box, 'gargamel' dumped players inside a pitch-black cave - many thought they had spawned at night or in hell - and the world outside was an outrageous landscape of overhangs, cliffs and floating rock. It became the first viral seed and the template for every seed showcase since.
notes: The spawn is literally inside a dark cave: dig up or toward the light to escape, then enjoy the terrain
Load it in Beta 1.3 through 1.7.3 for the original world; later versions generate different terrain from the same word
keywords: gargamel seed minecraft beta famous cave spawn first viral seed 2011

name: 404 Seed (404 Challenge)
version: Java Beta 1.3 - 1.7.3 (modern versions generate a different world)
story: Home of the legendary 404 Challenge. You spawn facing a small gravel hole in a beach: punch one block of gravel, the whole floor collapses, and you fall into a vast dark cave system. The community challenge that grew around it - gather what you can during one day, drop in at night, then survive underground with no torches and no return to the surface - became one of the first great Minecraft survival challenges.
notes: The gravel pit at spawn is the entrance: breaking one gravel block collapses the rest into the cave
Classic rules: one day of surface gathering, then underground forever - no torches allowed
Works in Beta 1.3 through 1.7.3; later updates changed the terrain and killed the challenge
keywords: 404 seed minecraft 404 challenge gravel cave no torches beta survival challenge

name: Glacier Seed
version: Java Beta 1.3 - 1.7.3 (modern versions generate a different world)
story: The third pillar of the Beta 1.3 golden age of seeds, remembered alongside gargamel and 404 in every classic-seed thread. 'Glacier' spawned players in a dramatic frozen world of towering ice-covered mountains and frozen lakes - the go-to showcase for how extreme old-school terrain could get, and a favorite for epic builds on impossible icy cliffs.
notes: Capital G matters: enter 'Glacier' exactly, seeds are case-sensitive
Load in Beta 1.3 through 1.7.3 for the original frozen terrain
A staple of retro-Minecraft modpacks that recreate the beta terrain generator
Perfect time capsule for seeing how far world generation has evolved since 2011
The wiki also lists the Beta 1.3_01 PC Gamer demo seed 'glacier' in all lowercase, a different world from the famous capital-G 'Glacier'
keywords: glacier seed minecraft beta famous ice mountains frozen terrain 2011 classic

name: North Carolina (Demo World Seed)
version: Any modern Java version (the demo world regenerates faithfully)
story: The world of Minecraft's official demo mode - the free trial that millions of players tried before buying - is generated from the seed "North Carolina". Type exactly that (with the space and capitals) into the seed box of any full Java version and the demo world appears: the same hills, the same river, the same starter chest. It is probably the most-played seed in history, and it was hiding in plain sight.
notes: The demo spawns you with a small bonus chest containing starter tools and torches
Works in modern Java - the demo world generates the same way it does in demo mode
Capitalization matters: type North Carolina exactly, with the space
The wiki's Demo Mode page gives the demo seed as -343522682, which is the text 'North Carolina'
keywords: minecraft demo world seed north carolina trial seed famous

name: worstseedever Seed
version: Java Beta 1.7.3 and earlier (modern versions generate a different world)
story: One of the first viral seeds ever, from the Beta era around 2011. Despite the name, it is a fantastic world: right at spawn, falling sand collapses to reveal a half-buried dungeon with a monster spawner and a loot chest. The ironic name made it a legend of early YouTube and forums.
notes: At spawn, watch the sand collapse: dig into it to find the buried dungeon with spawner and chest
Only works in Beta 1.7.3 and earlier - the 1.7.2 dungeon generation change broke it in modern versions (confirmed by the wiki)
keywords: worstseedever seed minecraft beta dungeon spawn famous classic

name: nyan Seed (Pocket Edition Legend)
version: Pocket Edition Alpha (2012, finite-world era - modern Bedrock generates a different world)
story: The most famous Pocket Edition seed ever. Back when MCPE worlds were small and finite, nyan spawned you facing a colossal mountain with overhangs, lava falls and ice - in a version where lava was almost mythical. A whole generation of mobile players built their first base in that cliff face, and the community later converted the original world file so it can still be played in modern Bedrock.
notes: The spawn faces a huge mountain with lava flows and ice - unforgettable in the finite-world era
Typing nyan in modern Bedrock creates a different world; the original survives as a community-preserved world file
Other beloved PE classics of the same era: 999 (double village) and Nether (rare lava)
keywords: nyan seed minecraft pocket edition classic mcpe famous mountain

name: 1.16 Title Panorama Seed
version: Java 1.16 (taken in snapshot 20w13a)
story: The background panorama of the Minecraft title screen during the Nether Update (1.16): a blue-green warped forest with its huge fungi. The community project Minecraft@Home located the exact seed and viewpoint in mid-2020, shortly after the snapshot released, using distributed computing across thousands of volunteer machines.
notes: Load it in Java 1.16 (or the 20w13a snapshot) for the exact panorama terrain
The viewpoint sits in a warped forest - the blue biome with huge warped fungi
The same project also found the pack.png seed and the Beta-era title panorama
keywords: 1.16 panorama seed title screen nether update warped forest 6006096527635909600

name: 1.14 Title Screen Panorama
version: Java 18w48a (1.14 snapshot) and later
story: The Village & Pillage panorama - a plains village buzzing with villagers at dawn - kept its seed secret for over three years until the panorama-cracking community pinned it down in 2022. The exact spot sits near spawn in a plains biome, so you can stand where the camera stood within a minute of creating the world.
notes: Stand at X=240.57, Y=78.12, Z=147.38 and face the village view to recreate the shot
The world spawns you in plains at 140, 100 - the panorama point is a short walk away
Best experienced on 1.14-era terrain generation; newer versions reshape the village

name: 1.15 Title Screen Panorama
version: Java 19w41a (1.15 snapshot) and later
story: The Buzzy Bees panorama shows bees drifting over a flower forest hillside at sunrise. Its seed was cracked by the community in the same 2022 effort that revealed the 1.14 panorama, ending another multi-year hunt - the bees had been hiding in plain sight the whole time.
notes: You spawn in a forest at 136, 56 - a decent hike from the panorama point, so bring a boat or use /tp
Visit on 1.15-era world generation for the authentic flower forest hillside
keywords: 1.15 panorama seed buzzy bees title screen flower forest bees

name: 1.20 Title Screen Panorama
version: Java 23w14a (1.20 snapshot) and later
story: The Trails & Tales panorama floats above a cherry grove valley with a ruined portal in the foreground - the first panorama shot in a 1.20 feature biome. Its seed was found by the panorama-cracking community in 2023, and the spot sits thousands of blocks from spawn, which is why /tp is your friend.
notes: Camera spot: X=1839.272, Y=128, Z=6312.295 - teleport, do not walk
Spawns you in a bamboo jungle at 16, -16, far from the cherry grove shot
Modern terrain generation: this one looks right in current versions
